summary: Built all three documents with the prescribed Make targets: the 38-page expansive study, the 12-page concise study and the 5-page homily, each settling in two passes and reproducing its exact bytes from a removed auxiliary file. All three logs are clean (no error, no LaTeX or package warning, no overfull or underfull box, no rerun request); PDF structure, metadata, font embedding (every face embedded, subsetted and Unicode-mapped) and complete text extraction check out; the page counts satisfy the 20-50 and 10-12 ranges; and the concise auxiliary file records inventory and all four overview senses on physical page 1, chronology on 2, themes on 3-4 and commentary beginning on 5. No layout repair was required, so no render source, timestamp or content seal was touched: the only working-tree changes are the snapshot the helper wrote to research/artifacts.json and the production audit appended to research/production-review.md. The snapshot, the artifacts-phase gate, the per-edition component checks and the leaf content preflight all pass, and 55 bounded page rasters with 4 contact sheets are prepared in this stage's raster child for the visual reviewer. Reported honestly for the artifact gate: the homily PDF and all three auxiliary files are byte-identical to the reviewed proofs and the study and concise PDFs differ only in the printed revision-timestamp line, but the study-review-0001 seal is stale at exactly one file, format.tex, which the concise stage extended after the study review with the two concise-only table environments; that extension provably changed nothing in the study's rendering, and this stage neither repaired nor restamped it. Nothing is installed and no page has had an independent visual review.
